name: Nap Zack
source: Lick's KemoShota (male furry cub) younger brother. Having pulmonary sickness, he has to stay in his bed. He likes to read books and translate the old ones[spoiler],while sometimes he looks for forbidden literature about aircraft as well as the outside world[/spoiler].
